biggest_catch: The top $25 only pays if the referred loan is actually FUNDED - a completed application alone earns just $10 - and rewards come as gift certificates to local businesses, not cash.
catches: Current member earns a $10 gift certificate for a completed loan application, or a $25 gift certificate if the new loan is funded.
Referral program applies only to secured loans (excluding share-secured loans).
A current member may refer a new OR an existing member for a new loan.
Members in the same household are not eligible for referral rewards.
Referred person must include the referrer's name on the Loan Referral Form.
Gift certificates are to local businesses - not cash or account credit.
